IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_FastForward_NormalH: Normal speed - stops fast forward for everyone
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_FastForward_AutoOn: Auto %1x: your timed actions fast forward at this speed. Right-click to turn it off
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_BodyStats_Tooltip: Change hunger, mood, health, nutrition, weight and the rest, like the debug menu's Body panel. Changes are made on the server, so they stick and the player sees them.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_BodyStats_NoAnswer: The server is not answering. Is it running this version of Zomboid Fixes?
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_BodyStats_Denied: You are not allowed to change %1's body.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Chopper_SendTooltip: Sends the chopper to a random online player, as the chopper event does. It flies in from far away, so it takes about a minute to be heard.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Chopper_StopTooltip: Removes the chopper at once and tells every player it is gone, including anyone who still hears a chopper that already left.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Chopper_Sent: Chopper sent to a random player
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Chopper_Denied: You are not allowed to call the chopper
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Chopper_Disabled: Chopper controls are off in sandbox options
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_BodyStats_Disabled: The body stats editor is switched off in the sandbox options.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddShor: Add a shortcut. Right-click the bar or a slot for more.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ResetCo: Replace every shortcut on the bar with the default set?
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_StateUn: State unknown here (the player is not near). Clicking flips it on the server.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Unknown: This shortcut's action no longer exists.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_NeedsAd: Needs a role with admin powers.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_NeedsBo: The body stats editor is off in the sandbox options.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_OpenWin: Open the window instead of running directly
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Setting: The vehicle I'm in, else the nearest
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ValueHi: leave empty to ask; true/false options toggle
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_PlayerN: That player is not near you, so their position and window are not available.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Locatio: That square is not loaded. Go closer to it.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RankToo: That player's role ranks above yours.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Vehicle: Vehicles can only be spawned on the ground floor.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_PlayerG: Switches god mode for a player, with the server's /godmodplayer command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_PlayerI: Switches invisibility for a player, with the server's /invisibleplayer command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_PlayerN: Lets a player walk through walls, with the server's /noclip command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SendPla: Teleports a player to a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_BringEv: Teleports every player who is not near you to where you stand, like the Debug menu's Teleport Players Here.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddXpTo: Adds XP in one skill to a player, with the server's /addxp command. A negative amount lowers the skill.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_CheckSt: Opens the Player Stats window for a player who is near you.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ManageI: Opens a player's inventory, as the Player Stats window's Manage Inventory button does.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Warning: Gives a player warning points, which go in their user log.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_MuteCha: Mutes all of a player's chat, as the Player Stats window does. The player must be near you.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_KickToo: Kicks a player from the server.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_BanTool: Bans a player from the server.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_VoiceBa: Bans or unbans a player from voice chat.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_BodySta: Opens the body stats editor for a player, or sends a saved set of body values (make one with the Body window's Add to Hotbar).
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_BodyCap: Saves the values changed in this window as a hotbar shortcut that sets them again.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_BodyNot: Change some values first; only the changed ones are saved.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Telepor: Teleports you to saved coordinates, or to a square you pick.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SpawnIt: Adds an item to a player's inventory, with the server's /additem command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Buildin: Gives you a key for the building you are standing in.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_KeyById: Gives a player a key with a given key ID.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SpawnVe: Spawns a vehicle, with the server's /addvehicle command. Ground floor only.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RandomV: Spawns a random vehicle where you stand.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Vehicle: Gives you a key for a vehicle.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Hotwire: Hotwires a vehicle, or undoes it if it already is.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Vehicle: Arms a vehicle's alarm, or disarms it if it is armed.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RemoveA: Removes every vehicle around you, with the server's /remove vehicles command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SpawnHo: Spawns zombies with the Horde Manager's settings, with the server's /createhorde2 command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_HordeNe: Spawns zombies around a player, with the server's /createhorde command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddZomb: Spawns one zombie on a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RemoveZ: Removes the zombies around a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RemoveC: Removes the corpses around you, with the server's /remove corpses command.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_MakeNoi: Makes a noise that attracts zombies.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_StartFi: Starts a fire on a square, like the Brush Tool's fire control.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Explosi: Makes an explosion on a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RainToo: Starts rain at a set intensity; click again to stop it. Green while it is raining.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Thunder: Starts a thunderstorm for a number of hours.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Weather: Starts a storm, tropical storm or blizzard, or generates weather, as Climate Control's Weather tab does.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Climate: Switches a saved set of Climate Control overrides on and off. Make one with Climate Control's Add to Hotbar.
Nothing saved yet: set the weather in Climate Control and use its Add to Hotbar.
Tick at least one override first.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Lightni: Strikes lightning with a flash near a player.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Thunder: Makes thunder heard near a player.
Strikes thunder at every online player, as the Trigger Thunder window's All does.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Gunshot: Plays a gunshot meta event somewhere in the distance.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Buildin: Sets off the alarm of the building you are standing in.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SendCho: Sends the chopper to a random online player.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RoadSto: Places a road story (crashed cars and the like) on a square on a road.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ZoneSto: Places a zone story (a camp, a picnic...) on a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddAnim: Adds an animal of a chosen breed on a square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddEncl: Builds a test animal enclosure where you stand.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ServerM: Broadcasts a message to every player.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ServerO: Sets a server option and reloads the options. A true/false option becomes a toggle.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_CheckMo: Asks the server whether any Workshop mod needs an update.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_HideMyC: Hides your own character on your screen, for filming.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_HideCur: Hides the mouse cursor, for filming. Bind a hotbar key to show it again.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddStep: Makes this shortcut do more than one thing: the step runs after the shortcut's own action, in order, on the same click.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_StepsAs: A player, square or vehicle asked for when used is asked once and used by every step.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_NoForag: That square is not in a foraging zone.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_UnbanTo: Lifts a player's ban (/unbanuser). Type the username: banned players are not online to pick.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ClearMa: Removes every symbol and note a player put on the shared map (/removemapsymbolsforuser).
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_RemoveI: Removes an item from your own inventory (/removeitem), for example after spawning too many.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Vehicle: Opens the Tools menu's HSV & Skin window for a vehicle.
Opens the Tools menu's Blood window for a vehicle.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_Release: Releases the safehouse on a square (/releasesafehouse), so it is no longer claimed.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ForageA: Adds forage icons for one item on a square, like the Debug menu's Foraging > Add Forage Icon Here. The icons are yours only: other players do not see them.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ForageB: Adds an icon for every item of a category (or every forage item) that can grow on the square, like the Debug menu's Foraging > Create Bulk Icons On This Square. The icons are yours only.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ForageR: Clears the forage icons of the zone and fills it again, like the Debug menu's Foraging > Clear And Refresh All Icons In This Zone.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ForageM: Moves every forage icon of the zone that can grow there onto one square, like the Debug menu's Foraging > Move All Forage Icons In Zone To This Square.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_ForageD: Shows the foraging debug overlay of the Debug menu's Search Mode panel. It draws while search mode is on.
Shows an arrow to every forage icon around you (the Search Mode panel's debug locations). Turns the debug info on too. Draws while search mode is on.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_CustomC: Runs any chat command. {me} is you, {player} a player (asked if not set), {x} {y} {z} a square you pick.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_AddToHo: Adds a shortcut to the admin hotbar with these settings.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_IconPic: Pick a tile set on the left.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_NeedsOt: Needs another player (split screen in single player).
